use_case: Dynamic ticket pricing and bot detection: the ticketing platform's smart pricing feature (machine-learning price suggestions, auto-apply mode available) and its bot protection on on-sales
vendor_or_model: Ticketing platform vendor (built-in machine-learning features of SYS-01; models not visible to the owner)
source_evidence: EV-004 (SYS-01 smart pricing and bot protection settings); EV-032 (vendor feature documentation); EV-037 (price change history); EV-049 (bot protection reports and fan emails)
data_categories: Sales velocity, tickets remaining, days to show, page views, and the owner's price settings (pricing); device, browser, network, and timing signals per session (bot protection). No patron-level data in pricing per vendor documentation
consequential_decision_category: None (ticket prices and on-sale access are not consequential decisions under the repository rubric)
human_in_the_loop: Pricing: owner approves each suggested change (suggest-only mode from 2026-09-01) within floors and ceilings; accessible seating excluded from automatic changes. Bot protection: automated per session; the owner reviews appeals and releases blocked fans by hand
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 464.2 (total price in every display); FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1)); 28 CFR 36.302(f)(1)(ii) and (f)(3) (seated shows); BOTS Act 15 U.S.C. 45c and Fla. Stat. 817.36(5) (protect the owner)

use_case: Consumer generative AI chatbot used by the marketing assistant to draft show descriptions and social posts
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI chatbot (free plan); no business terms
source_evidence: EV-033 (marketing assistant's answers); EV-023 (no AI payment on statements); EV-050 (chat history review 2026-08-12)
data_categories: Show details and public artist information only. One patron complaint email (name and email) was pasted in 2026-06
human_in_the_loop: The owner or assistant edits every draft before posting; prices are added from the live event page, never from the draft
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1)) for claims in posts; 16 CFR 464.2 for any price in a post; POL-01 9.5 (no patron data)
